persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Brian, 27, in Kisumu. You have just opened a small shop, Kilele Phones, selling phones, chargers and earphones, and you fix phones too. Every evening the cash is a little short and you don't know why, and some customers who took things on deni have not paid. Today you set up Duka for your shop.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called Duka. In about four minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
Duka means shop. It is for a small shop that sells phones and electronics: phones, chargers, earphones, TVs, solar lamps, and repairs.
The problem: a busy shop owner sells all day, but in the evening does not know the profit, the cash is short and nobody knows why, and customers who owe are forgotten.
Duka keeps all of it on the owner's phone. It works with no internet. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you send it.
This is the example shop: Baraka Electronics in Nakuru, run by Wanjiru. At the bottom are six tabs: Today, Sell, Stock, Customers, Offers and Money.
Today shows sales today, the profit, the cash that should be in the drawer, and what should be on M-Pesa.
Needs you is the to-do list the app makes by itself: items running low, a repair ready, a customer who owes money.
Now Sell. Find the item by typing a few letters, or tap one of the quick buttons.
Here is a Tecno Spark 20 and a screen protector. Plus and minus change how many. The price box lets you write the price you agreed with the customer.
If the price is below what you paid, Duka warns you. No more selling at a loss by mistake.
Type the customer's name and phone. Ask if they want offers by WhatsApp. Kenya's law says they must agree first.
Paid by M-Pesa, cash, card, or deni, which means they pay later. For M-Pesa, paste the confirmation message, and Duka fills in the code and checks the amount.
Save, and the receipt is ready, with the warranty date. Send it on WhatsApp so the customer keeps it.
Stock. Every sale takes the item out of stock. The coloured label shows what is left, and what is running low.
When new stock comes in, open the item and tap Restock. It adds to the stock and records what you paid the supplier.
The reorder list writes the order for your supplier, ready for WhatsApp.
Customers. Everyone you sold to is here, with what they bought.
Owe me shows deni: who owes, how much, since when. Remind sends a polite message. Record payment when they pay.
Repairs: write down what came in, mark it ready, tell the customer, and record the payment when they collect.
Offers is the marketing. Write one message, like new stock or a weekend offer, and choose who gets it: everyone, or only people who bought a phone.
Then tap each name. WhatsApp opens with their name already in the message. You press send. Duka shows who came back and bought.
Money. Every evening, count the cash in the drawer and check the M-Pesa balance. Duka says if it matches, or how much is short.
Money out: rent, KPLC tokens, transport. Paste the M-Pesa message and it fills in by itself.
Bills: rent, wages and internet each month. Paying a bill also records it as money out.
The report writes itself: sales, profit, money out, the cash count, deni, low stock and offers. Copy it to WhatsApp.
That is Duka: sell, keep stock, count the cash, remember who owes, and bring customers back. Asante for watching.

challenge.intro: Now you are Brian in Kisumu. Your shop starts empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press: use what you learned. Do not send any WhatsApp or SMS. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Use the NORMAL app link (not the 🧪 test copy). Open Duka. If it says “Karibu to Duka”, tap “✨ Start fresh with my own shop”. If a shop is already there, go to 💵 Money → ⚙️ Settings → “🧹 Start over — clear everything” → OK. Set up your shop: shop name Kilele Phones, your first name Brian, town Kisumu, till number 123456.

tasks.text: Your shop is called Kilele Phones, in Kisumu, with till number 123456.
tasks.hint: Check the spelling in 💵 Money → ⚙️ Settings, and tap Save settings.

tasks.text: Put three items in stock: Tecno Spark 20 (you paid 14,500, you sell at 16,999, 5 in stock), Oraimo earphones (paid 450, sell 950, 10 in stock) and Fast charger (paid 350, sell 800, 12 in stock).
tasks.hint: 📦 Stock → ＋ Add item, once for each. “You paid” is the cost, “You sell at” is the price.

tasks.text: Sell one Tecno Spark 20 to Otieno Juma (phone 0711 222 333), paid by M-Pesa.
tasks.hint: In 🛒 Sell, the customer's name goes in “Customer” and a phone box appears for a new customer.

tasks.text: Mama Atieno (phone 0722 444 555) takes a pair of Oraimo earphones on deni. Two days later — today — she pays 500 of it by cash.
tasks.hint: Deni is one of the “Paid by” buttons. The payment is recorded under 👥 Customers → 📒 Owe me.

tasks.text: You paid the shop rent, 15,000, from the bank. Record it.
tasks.hint: 💵 Money → ➖ Money out, or add it as a bill in 🧾 Bills and tap Pay.

tasks.text: Close the day: count the cash.
Make an offer for everyone who said yes: the new Samsung Galaxy A15. (Do not send it.)
tasks.hint: 📣 Offers → 📣 New offer → Save and start sending. If the item list is empty, write the message yourself.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: record every sale, with M-Pesa, cash or deni, and a receipt
keep stock and know what to reorder
count the cash and know where the money went
remember who owes and bring customers back with offers

daily.task: Use Duka for your pretend shop: record one sale, one money out, or a cash count.

explore.name: 🏠 Today
explore.try: Tap every button in Needs you. Tap a recent sale.

explore.name: 🛒 Sell
explore.try: Search “zzz”. Add three items, use − until one disappears, type letters in a price, try each Paid by button, type a cash amount smaller than the total.

explore.name: 🧾 The receipt
explore.find: Save a sale, or tap a recent sale on Today.
explore.try: Copy it. Delete a sale (the items go back into stock).

explore.name: 📦 Stock
explore.try: Every category button, the search, Add item with no name, a price below the cost, Restock with 0, Delete.

explore.name: 👥 Customers
explore.try: Add a customer, open one, untick “said yes to offers”, search a phone number.

explore.name: 📒 Owe me (deni)
explore.try: Record a payment bigger than what is owed. Record a payment of 0.

explore.name: 🔧 Repairs
explore.try: Save a repair with no item. Mark ready, Tell them (don't send), Collected & paid with 0.

explore.name: 📣 Offers
explore.try: Each ready-made message, each “Who gets it?” button, an empty message, Delete an offer.

explore.name: 🧮 Cash count
explore.try: Save with nothing typed, a number that matches, a number that is over.

explore.name: ➖ Money out / ➕ Money in
explore.find: 💵 Money → ➖ Money out, then ➕ Money in.
explore.try: Paste a message that is not M-Pesa. Save with no category. Delete an entry.

explore.name: 🧾 Bills
explore.try: Add a bill, Pay, Undo, go to next month and Copy last month's bills.

explore.name: 📊 Report & ⚙️ Settings
explore.try: Today / This week / This month, the CSV button, Download backup, change the shop name and save.
